MEET THE ARTIST / 블랙스트링

Black String

Black String brings Korean traditional instruments, electric guitar and electronics together through improvisation. Geomungo player Yoon Jeong Heo leads the quartet.

BY INDIEK / PUBLISHED 2026-11-12

Listen ↓Inside the music ↓
SONG PAGESMask Dance ↗

The group grew out of a 2011 project with British jazz musicians, with percussionist Min Wang Hwang joining Heo, guitarist Jean Oh and multi-instrumentalist Aram Lee afterward. ACT released their album Mask Dance in 2016.

JAZZ / CROSSOVER / 2016

Mask Dance

Live performance

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Mask Dance” takes its inspiration from Cheoyongmu, a Korean dance performed wearing Cheoyong’s mask to drive away spirits. Genie’s release notes describe the composition as a musical expression of the story’s strange and mysterious imagery.

Music by Yoon Jeong Heo, Jean Oh and Aram Lee; arranged by Yoon Jeong Heo, Jean Oh and Aram Lee. Album produced by Yoon Jeong Heo.
